title: Forgery; penalties.
bodyText: Any person who shall forge any official device, seal, or mark, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor.
bodyHtml: §486-30  Forgery; penalties.  Any person who shall forge any official device, seal, or mark, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. [L 1988, c 156, pt of §3; am L 1991, c 153, §16]
